action_summary: Reverted the inference pipeline toward the best-scoring configuration (v15: multi-head model, raw probabilities). The model architecture is now chosen automatically from the checkpoint's state-dict keys (MultiHeadResNeXt when head_0.* keys exist, SingleHeadModel only when head_fc.* keys exist), so the multi-head weights are used whenever present and loading cannot fail from an architecture mismatch. The fold loop iterates over folds 0-4 but skips missing checkpoints and stacks only the folds actually used, so the ensemble uses the maximum number of available folds. CONVERT_TO_RANK was set back to False since rank averaging lowered the score in the latest comparisons. Submission format (StudyInstanceUID + 11 class columns, submission.csv) is unchanged.
